title: [29.x] - Bug 650481[Expense Agent] Closed travel requests are editable and are missing approver info.
summary: Travel requests can no longer be edited once closed, automatic approvals now record the approver details, and the requested-for user name is displayed on the travel request card.
key_points: Closed travel requests are now read-only to prevent unintended modifications
Automatic approval process now captures and stores approver identity and timestamp
Travel request card displays the name of the expense user the request was made for
Fixes issues with spend request editability and missing approval metadata
Includes test coverage for the fixed scenarios
quote: Closed travel requests can still be edited, and automatically approved travel requests do not record approver information.
